card.capacity_status_quote: Indium phosphide has been the key constraint for us for a number of quarters—it is a constraint for the industry.
card.demand_direction_quote: Customer demand remains exceptionally strong with no signs of attenuation, and our visibility continues to extend further into the future with orders now reaching into calendar 2028 and customer LTAs extending to the end of the decade.
card.pricing_power_quote: We also saw pricing optimization benefits increase significantly quarter on quarter and year over year, not only in Industrial but quite sizably in Data Center and Communications.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We expect strong sequential revenue growth in our June quarter, and we continue to expect fiscal 2027 growth to exceed our fiscal 2026 growth rate.
card.constraint_owner_quote: On the supply side—that is really more of our focus—demand looks great, and we are ramping supply very quickly.
